name: Anime Galaxies | UPDATE 0
desc:
🌌 Welcome to ANIME GALAXIES 🌌

Summon legendary champions, build your dream team, and defend your base across iconic anime worlds! ⚔️

✨ FEATURES ✨
🎰 Summon champions from rotating banners, with Mythic, Secret and Shiny units to chase
💪 Power up with traits, stat rerolls, evolutions and leveling
💀 Take on Nightmare mode for bigger rewards
🏆 New challenges every 15 minutes, plus Daily and Weekly challenges with bonus rewards
🎟️ Climb the Season Pass and complete quests for gems

👥 Join the group for exclusive perks!
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game for codes and updates!

llm.loop: summon anime champions from banners -> place units to defend base in waves -> earn gems/gold -> power up with traits, rerolls, evolutions -> harder modes and challenges
llm.objectives: build the strongest team and clear stages, Nightmare mode, challenges
llm.progression: unit rarity (Mythic, Secret, Shiny), levels, traits, evolutions, season pass
llm.instructions: summon champions, build your team, defend your base across anime worlds
llm.thumbnails: anime-style art of Goku-like, Gojo-like and Sukuna-like characters clashing with the ANIME GALAXIES logo
llm.complexity_notes: many unit models with ability animations, gacha, trait and evolution systems, multiple modes
